_about: Drinking-water guideline values for PFAS in groundwater. Values are stored as strings so they load as exact decimals. Verified 2026-09-23 against the primary sources named in each rule.

rules.name: PFAS NEMP 3.0 drinking-water values
rules.document: PFAS National Environmental Management Plan Version 3.0 (HEPA, March 2025)
rules.wa_status: The WA government PFAS page (Environment WAtch) names NEMP 3.0 as adopted for implementation in Western Australia.

limits.note: Applies to PFOS on its own, PFHxS on its own, and the sum of the two (Table 4, footnote a). Compare each of the three with 0.07 ug/L.
Compare PFOA on its own with 0.56 ug/L.

rules.name: Current ADWG drinking-water values (NHMRC, updated 2025)
rules.document: PFAS National Environmental Management Plan Version 3.1 (HEPA 2026), listing the NHMRC Australian Drinking Water Guidelines 2011 as updated in 2025
rules.wa_status: National guidance. As of 23 September 2026 no WA statement adopting NEMP 3.1 was found.

limits.note: Compare PFOS on its own with 0.008 ug/L (8 ng/L). Under this rule PFOS and PFHxS are screened separately, not as a sum.
Compare PFHxS on its own with 0.03 ug/L (30 ng/L). Under this rule PFOS and PFHxS are screened separately, not as a sum.
Compare PFOA on its own with 0.2 ug/L (200 ng/L).
Compare PFBS on its own with 1 ug/L (1000 ng/L).
